import json,collections
with open('records/phase-4/crpacks.jsonld') as f: packs=json.load(f)['@graph']
with open('records/phase-4/cr_extensions.jsonld') as f: extensions=json.load(f)['@graph']
def many(v): return v if isinstance(v,list) else [v]
pairs={(doc,p['@id']) for p in packs for doc in many(p['hasCR'])}
epairs={(e['@id'],p) for e in extensions for p in many(e['belongsToCRPack'])}
print('pack-member pairs',len(pairs),'extension-pack pairs',len(epairs))
print('pack-only pairs',len(pairs-epairs),'extension-only pairs',len(epairs-pairs))
print('multiple packs per document',sum(v>1 for v in collections.Counter(doc for doc,p in pairs).values()))
PY"

Release questions also required matching TDoc release and specification metadata. Repeated evidence producing identical requested rows was deduplicated.
